dedupe_keys.name: context aware demand prediction in bike sharing systems incorporating spatial meteorological and calendrical context

description: The implemented recurrent model feeds historical spatial, weather, calendar and situational information through multivariate masks and uses prospective context to regularize forecasts. It predicts station check-in/check-out demand to inform balancing and bicycle relocation. The project catalogue explicitly relates the study to GIRA occupancy and weather/event inputs. The paper reports that some context-aware improvements are not statistically significant. The model is therefore represented with those experimental limits, without a claim that every contextual variable improves prediction. A separate public trained-model or code release is not established. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with restricted document or data access and licence label not stated. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
